plugin.description:
The one-stop shop to your cosmic exploration needs! This plugin is meant to be a collective source of being able to grind out your gather and crafter relics, while also being able to help grind out the score to 500k on each class for that sleek black mech that you want ~.

- Has the ability to re-roll missions for you until you get the desired one that you want to farm
- Crafters can be fully automated with support of artisan. 
- Fisher can also be fully automated with the support of AutoHook and Navmesh
- Botanist/Miner only need Navmesh, thanks to having gathering built in directly to the plugin <3. 
- Setup what items you want to buy from the shop for cosmocredits, or spend your planetary tokens on the cosmowheel of fortune!
plugin.summary: Welcome to, the dark side of, the MOOOON

website.readmeExcerpt: # Ices Cosmic Exploration (ICE) Repo: `https://puni.sh/api/repository/ice` Welcome to the moon plugin that makes that dreadful grind of the moon into something that can be automated and made so much simplier. The overall purpose of this is to help you re-roll and grind out certain Cosmic Exploration missinos. From anywhere on trying to get gold on every mission for that title, to grinding out relic experience so you get your crafter/gathering tools. Or even if you're grinding up to 500k points on each and every class. Features: ✔️ Re-roll until you get the missions that you would like to grind ✔️ Allow it to automatically chose which one is most optimal with "Relic XP Grind" and find the missions that fit your relic experience needs so you can finish those tools ✔️ Select at what point you would like to turn in a mission (Bronze, Silver, Gold) to select when you would like to turnin ✔️ Be able to prioritize what classes you would like to farm with priority farm mode, and cycle through classes/mission types for weather/timed/sequence missions Requirements: ### Crafting - Artisan | Repo: `https://github.com/PunishXIV/Artisan` ### Fishing - Autohook | Repo: `https://github.com/InitialDet/AutoHook` - How to auto-accept collectables: `https://github.com/PunishXIV/AutoHook/blob/main/AcceptCollectable.md` ### Gathering Just need navmesh - Vnavmesh | Repo: `https://github.com/awgil/ffxiv_navmesh` There is an in plugin window that goes over the specifics of each kind/will also show give you buttons to install plugins if you don't have them already.
website.title: Ices-Cosmic-Exploration

variant.author: Ice, RedAsteroid(汉化)
variant.changelog:
- 上游修改: 修复"寻路移动卡住时跳跃"无效问题(遗物探索某个点位需要跳跃),
  修改采集逻辑: 恢复采集次数技能将在采集点只剩1或2次时使用, 并且至少会使用一次以避免浪费, 扩展研究现在会优先于GP技能使用
  请注意! 自动遗物探索绝对不要无人看管时启用, 部分点位明确存在寻路卡死问题
- 对 MeowZWR 维护的 Artisan 分支增加了额外的 IPC 通信兼容

API 14，如果无法加载请删除配置文件重新加载
- 基本汉化与文本适配
- 对 MissFisher 的宇宙探索功能进行适配
- 新增功能: 自动离开设置为不切换(防椅子)
- 新增设置: 自动在钓鱼任务开始时抛竿(适配 MissFisher 逻辑)
variant.description:
满足您的宇宙探索需求的一站式服务中心! 本插件旨在成为一个综合工具, 让您能够刷取采集与制作职业的宇宙工具, 同时也能帮助您将每个职业的技巧点刷到 50 万, 以获得那台您梦寐以求的的帅气黑色机甲~

- 能够为您反复刷新任务, 直到您想要刷的那个任务出现
- 制作职业在 Artisan 的支持下可以实现完全自动化
- 捕鱼人也能在 AutoHook 和 Navmesh 的支持下实现完全自动化(支持 MissFisher)
- 园艺工/采矿工只需要 Navmesh, 多亏了插件直接内置了采集功能 <3
- 设置您想用宇宙信用点在商店购买的物品, 或使用行星信用点来玩宇宙好运道!

这是一个实验性的本地化分支，可能存在潜在错误需要捉虫
请勿通过闲鱼小店购买此插件，一分钱都不该付

如果无法加载请删除配置文件重新加载
钓鱼任务默认使用 AutoHook 内置预设, 如需使用 MissFisher 请禁用 AutoHook
variant.name: Ice's Cosmic Exploration
variant.punchline: 欢迎来到, 月球的黑暗面……
